_comment: Copy to settings.json and adjust. Every key is optional; an empty string means auto-detect / default.
_profileDir: X4 profile folder holding config.xml. Empty = the numeric folder under Documents\Egosoft\X4 whose config.xml was written last.
_gameExe: Full path of X4.exe. Empty = <this folder>\..\..\X4.exe if it exists, else ANY process named X4 counts as the running game.
_backupDir: Where config.xml backups go (timestamped, never deleted by the tool). Empty = <this folder>\backups.
_companionSkipFlag: File created while cockpit mode is on, for a companion-window launcher to honour. Empty = <stateDir>\cockpit-active.flag, 'none' = no flag.
_centreMatch: Regex on the EDID code (e.g. AUS3438) or monitor name of the centre monitor. Empty = the primary monitor.
_sideMatch: Regex on the EDID code or name of the side monitors (e.g. DELD05F|P2714H). Empty = any other monitor.

cockpit._comment: Exactly these config.xml keys are written by cockpit-on (set one to null to leave it alone).
